$comment: Layer-05 delta L05-D001 (TOOL-016 / TOOL-003): JavaScript string values inside the runtime-validation SCHEMA. Scenarios live in conformance/agent/schema-domain/*.json, discriminated by a top-level `schema_domain` key. For each case a runner registers ONE tool whose ToolDefinition.parameters is the decoded `schema` (no prepare_arguments), makes ONE call whose raw arguments are the decoded `arguments`, and observes only the outcome through the REAL Layer-06 pipeline: `accept` (validation passed and execute ran) or `reject` (the certified immediate argument-validation error, TOOL-003). Registration itself must accept every schema here. VALUE GRAMMAR: {"utf16": units} is a string (UTF-16 code units 0..65535, so unpaired surrogates survive the file); {"$keys": [[units, value], ...]} is an object (keys as code units, in order); arrays are arrays; numbers, true, false and null are themselves. The runner performs no validation, normalization or conversion of its own.
